patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (her mother) Four days now. She's eating, she's playing, she's completely herself — but she cries when she goes and now she won't even try.
presentation.triageNote: Four-year-old female with four days without a bowel movement and hard painful stools; she is playful with a soft abdomen, no vomiting and no fever.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this playful child has a soft abdomen, no vomiting or fever, and a functional constipation pattern requiring no counted resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This child has stool withholding and hard painful stools without obstruction or systemic illness.
clinical.acuityReason: This playful child has a soft abdomen, no vomiting or fever, and a functional constipation pattern requiring no counted resource.
teachingPoints: Playful, soft abdomen, no bilious vomiting, passing wind — this is functional constipation, not obstruction. The withholding cycle is the real problem to break.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Oral bowel regimen, diet and toileting guidance, and return precautions would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a hispanic 4-year-old girl in a bright t-shirt and leggings, sitting on a blue padded clinic chair holding a stuffed toy
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting cross-legged on the chair, hugging a stuffed rabbit, feet tucked up
signs: a stuffed rabbit hugged to her chest
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a hispanic 4-year-old girl in a bright t-shirt and leggings, sitting on a blue padded clinic chair holding a stuffed toy. Pose: sitting cross-legged on the chair, hugging a stuffed rabbit, feet tucked up. Expression: cheerful and curious, entirely unbothered. Clearly visible: a stuffed rabbit hugged to her chest; bright alert eyes. Overall: completely well and playing happily. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
